subject: RESOLVED: the gate count is deterministic; a git worktree silently subtracts the 14 xs rows (pclxs is a sibling of the CHECKOUT)
description:
RESOLVED s319 — and my first reading was WRONG, recorded here so nobody
re-derives it.

I measured 4453 (working tree) vs 4439 (HEAD in a git worktree), both PASS, and
first wrote this up as run-to-run NONDETERMINISM.  It is not.  The gate count is
deterministic per environment; the two runs were in DIFFERENT PLACES.

CAUSE: Pl/t/xs-01.t:24-25 does
    my $pcl_root = "$FindBin::Bin/../..";
    my $pclxs    = $ENV{PCLXS_DIR} || "$pcl_root/../pclxs";
i.e. pclxs is resolved as a sibling OF THE CHECKOUT, and the file plan skip_all's
(contributing 0 rows) when it is absent or libpclxs.so is unbuilt.
  from /home/bernt/pcl        -> /home/bernt/pclxs        EXISTS + built -> runs
  from /tmp/.../wt-head       -> /tmp/.../pclxs           ABSENT        -> skips
xs-01 6 + xs-02 4 + xs-03 4 = **exactly 14** = the difference.  Arithmetic
closes; nothing is flaky and no test was lost.

CONFIRMED DETERMINISTIC: the working tree measured 4453 twice, minutes apart.

ALSO CONFIRMED: the File::Spec change (#167) costs ZERO tests — the three Pl/t
files that mention File::Spec measure 200 in BOTH trees.

THE REUSABLE LESSON (now in CLAUDE.md's test-status bullet): a `git worktree` is
still the correct way to compare against HEAD — never a stash-copy (s318) — but
it CHANGES ENVIRONMENT-DEPENDENT SKIPS because it lives at a different path.
Either set PCLXS_DIR=~/pclxs for the worktree run, or expect the 14-row delta.
Same family as #151 (a fixture difference masquerading as data) and #157 (a
missing measurement masquerading as a clean run).

RESIDUE, deliberately not chased: CLAUDE.md's old figure was 4452, and
4452 + 3 (the tests dc15cbb and be312cc added after it was recorded) = 4455,
not the measured 4453.  So the s318 figure was itself ~2 off.  It has been
replaced with both measured values and their condition, so the discrepancy
cannot propagate further.
